kernel: Kokkos::Impl::CudaReductionsFunctor<FunctorType,void,false,false>::scalar_intra_warp_reduction (broadcast tail), inlined into cuda_parallel_launch_local_memory<ParallelReduce<RwSumFunctor, RangePolicy<Cuda>, InvalidType, Cuda>> (driver: scalar parallel_reduce, n = 1000, double)

sites.source: *value = *(value - lane_id);   (the store half: lane 0 stores back into its own slot, i.e. slot[warp base + 0], the value it already holds)
sites.operation: st.shared.f64 (SASS STS.64 [R9], Rx; R9 = &value = this lane's own slot; executed by every lane, the conflicting one is lane 0)

sites.source: *value = *(value - lane_id);   (the load half: every lane loads lane 0's slot, value - lane_id)
sites.operation: ld.shared.f64 (SASS LDS.64 Rx, [R0]; R0 = value - lane_id = slot of lane 0 of the warp; the conflicting readers are lanes 1..31)

thread_pair_example: block 0, warp 0: thread 0 (lane 0) executes STS.64 to slot 0 of the warp (self-assignment, same value) while thread 1 (lane 1) executes LDS.64 from slot 0 (lanes 1..31 all read slot 0). The last __syncwarp(mask) of the tree loop is at L549 (before both); no barrier separates the load of lane 1 from the store of lane 0. Same pair in every warp of every block in the width-32 call (ReduceScan.hpp:562-:563). The width-(blockDim.y/32) call (:573-:574) runs in warp 0 only (:568), and there lanes 1..31 all load slot 0 of the block's buffer (value - lane_id with lane_id = threadIdx.y % 32).
class_reason: Both accesses are plain shared-memory accesses (Scalar* is not volatile; PTX ld.shared.f64 / st.shared.f64 with no .volatile/.relaxed/atomic qualifier; SASS LDS.64/STS.64 without a .STRONG token). Two lanes of one warp access one shared address, one of them a store, with no ordering between them -> data race of two plain accesses (DR). No strong or atomic access is part of the pair, so no SC component. The store is value-preserving (lane 0 rewrites the value it already holds), so results are always correct; whether a detector filters same-value stores is a detector question, not part of the ground truth.
buggy_expected: The pair is reported as DR, intra-warp: the STS.64 and the LDS.64 of source line 551 (both roles on L551, as in the racecheck output quoted in the fix commit message: Read at :551 and Write at :551, 144 hazards for n=1). The buggy program also contains the second hazard below (ReduceScan.hpp:575 write vs Parallel_Range.hpp:321 read), which is not the target pair.

residual_sites.operation: st.shared.f64 / SASS STS.64 [R7.X8+-0x8] (in the last-block instance, where result = shared + (blockDim.y - 1); the other instance stores to global with st.global.f64 / STG.E.64)
ld.shared.u32 / SASS LDS R9, [R0.X4] (32-bit word loads of the 8-byte value, threads with threadIdx.y < word_count = 2)

fixed.reason: The targeted pair (L551 broadcast) is absent: the fix wraps the broadcast in 'if (lane_id != 0)' (L551-L553 of the fixed file; the store and load are now at L552, SASS @P1 LDS.64 [R0] / @P1 STS.64 [R9] predicated off for lane 0), so lane 0 no longer stores into the slot that lanes 1..31 read. The fixed program is NOT report-free: it still contains the separate hazard quoted in the fix commit message (racecheck 'After': Write ReduceScan.hpp:577 vs Read Parallel_Range.hpp:321, 4 hazards), an intra-warp RAW for the 8-byte result because the __syncthreads at Parallel_Range.hpp:316 only runs when WarpSize < word_count. That residual is the same in the buggy variant (L575 there) and must not be scored against the L551 pair. Also present in both builds, unchanged by the fix, and not the target pair: the two intra-warp conflicts listed in extra_pairs_both_builds (tree-loop step conflict at :547, and in warp 0's width-(blockDim.y/32) call the :551/:552 loads of slot 0 by lanes of other mask groups against lane 0's :547 stores). A fixed-build report of (:552 load, :547 or FunctorAdapter.hpp:1571 store) is the latter, not the target. If, as sass_notes says, ptxas emitted no WARPSYNC for the full-mask __syncwarp at :549, a SASS-level detector may also see the width-32 call's :547 last-step store by lane 0 and the :551/:552 loads as unordered. PTX orders them (bar.warp.sync), so that report would be a model-boundary artifact, as in CLAUDE.md T21 item 2.

sass_notes: sm_89 SASS of the driver (cuobjdump/nvdisasm -g, kernel cuda_parallel_launch_local_memory<ParallelReduce<RwSumFunctor,...>>), buggy: L551 appears 4 times (2 call sites x 2 inlined scalar_intra_block_reduction instances), each as a pair LDS.64 R14,[R0] ... STS.64 [R9],R14 at offsets 0x0560/0x05d0, 0x0a40/0x0a70, 0x11c0/0x11f0, 0x1660/0x1680 (the load feeds the store directly, load first). Neither carries a .STRONG token (plain LDS/STS; volatile is not involved at this site, the pointer is a plain Scalar*). The tree loop above it (L545-L549) has a YIELD at L546 but NO WARPSYNC for the __syncwarp(mask) at L549: ptxas removed it (full mask), so between the last tree step and the broadcast nothing in the SASS orders the lanes. Sync instructions of the region (line-table attribution): BAR.SYNC at L566 (0x05e0, 0x1200) and L591 (0x03d0), WARPSYNC 0xffffffff attributed to L566 (0x11d0, directly before the BAR.SYNC at 0x1200); none is attributed to L549 or to the __syncwarp(0xffffffff) at L572. Fixed: the same pair is @P1 LDS.64 [R0] / @P1 STS.64 [R9] at L552 (offsets 0x0570/0x05e0, 0x0a50/0x0a80, 0x11c0/0x1200, 0x1670/0x1690), predicated by lane_id != 0. The residual STS.64 at L577 is at 0x16b0 (fixed) with LDS R9,[R0.X4] at Parallel_Range.hpp:321, 0x1810. SASS arch: sm_89 only plus compute_89 PTX (cuda_elfs.py: 18 cubin(s) sm_89; PTX sm_89), built -O3 -lineinfo via Kokkos' CMake; Kokkos_ARCH_AMPERE86 with -arch=sm_86 rewritten to sm_89 (this revision has no ADA89).

extra_pairs_both_builds.why_unordered: In the call at :573-:574 (fixed :575-:576), width = blockDim.x*blockDim.y/32 <= 8 because the block has at most 256 threads (Parallel_Range.hpp:329-:351 start at 256 and only halve). The mask :536-:540 is then ((1<<width)-1) << (tid/width)*width, so the __syncwarp(mask) calls (:543, :549) only synchronise lanes of one width-lane group. Lanes >= width are never synchronised with lane 0 after the full-mask __syncwarp at :572. Their :551 load of slot 0 is therefore unordered against lane 0's stores of slot 0 in the tree loop. The same holds for their :551 store to their own slot k against a lower group's tree-loop load of slot k (e.g. lane 7 loading slot 8 at delta = 1): DR. Present in both builds; the fix only predicates lane 0.

review.notes: Target confirmed at 8741579: core/src/Cuda/Kokkos_Cuda_ReduceScan.hpp:551 '*value = *(value - lane_id);' right after the tree loop :545-:549 of scalar_intra_warp_reduction (:529-:552) in CudaReductionsFunctor<F, Tag, false, false>. That specialization is chosen for value size <= 16 bytes (ReduceScan.hpp:885-:889, UseShfl = StaticValueSize > 16). Lane 0 stores slot 0 (value-preserving), and lanes 1..31 load slot 0 with no sync between them. Both use Scalar* (plain), so DR, intra-warp. The class does not depend on D20. The fix db1a77d wraps it in 'if (lane_id != 0)' (fixed :551-:553), so the target pair is absent in the fixed build. Residual (both builds) confirmed: thread 0 stores *result at :575 (fixed :577) into shared slot blockDim.y-1 in the last block (:616-:618). Thread 1 then loads word 1 of it at Kokkos_Cuda_Parallel_Range.hpp:321 'global[i] = shared[i]'. The __syncthreads at :316 runs only if WarpSize < word_count (2 for a double): intra-warp RAW, DR, as in the fix commit's racecheck output. The driver source (RwSumFunctor) was not read. Either FunctorValueJoin specialization for a scalar accesses the slots through volatile casts, which is the basis of extra_pairs_both_builds. SASS opcodes, tokens and offsets quoted in sites/sass_notes were not re-checked: the one allowed srun (-p normal -t 10) could not start (partition full, estimated start 2026-10-21 14:37) and was cancelled. Everything above is from the upstream sources at the two commits.
